hypothesis: A real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks volatility risk premium trade (long/short ATM straddle sized by the IV-realized-vol spread, delta-hedged in the perpetual) is net-of-cost tradable for the underlying BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized Deribit data.

protocol.title: Real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks volatility risk premium / realized-vs-implied vol net-of-cost falsification
protocol.surface_to_iv: per real 5m snapshot & front expiry at a common strike nearest spot: series IV = mean(call IV, put IV), each backed out of each real mark (implied_volatility(mark*spot, spot, K, 0, T, type))
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge turnover HEDGE_FEE_BPS on |Δhedge|*S; each of the 2 straddle legs pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit; full spread charged on VRP side flips
protocol.option_spread: each of the 2 straddle legs pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit (long and short legs both charged the round-trip spread); full spread charged when the VRP side flips between steps
protocol.pnl: dOption_k = side_k*exposure_k*(straddle_mark_{k+1}-straddle_mark_k)*S_k; gross_k = dOption_k + hedge_k*dS_k (hedge = -side*exposure*straddle_delta); ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k; decision at bar k -> outcome over [k,k+1] (causal)
protocol.vrp_rule: side = +1 (long straddle) when IV < realized (buy vol), -1 (short straddle) when IV > realized (sell vol), 0 when equal; exposure = clip(|IV - realized| / vol_target, 0, size_cap)
protocol.common_strike_rule: nearest-to-spot strike quoted call+put in the front expiry; else config invalid
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
